about: Positive control for the SAM 3.1 plate probe (issue #8). Every photo in test/fixtures/acceptance and test/fixtures/depth-set was looked at by eye (2026-10-30), zoomed where a vehicle appeared. Boxes are hand-drawn, slightly loose, in the source pixels of the fixture as committed. Plate text is deliberately not recorded. 'sure: false' marks a lit rectangle that is probably a plate but too dark or blurred to tell; it is scored apart from the sure plates.
